scope: DEV001 revalidates requirements, applicability and architecture, then builds a new inert offline engineering foundation. This mapping does not authorize business operations.
source_scope: Relative paths identify non-code design inputs in the previous contracts package. They do not import previous implementation or acceptance evidence.

classification_rules.confirmed: A retained product outcome or intended technology choice; not an implemented capability or field-level design approval.
classification_rules.proposal: A candidate engineering, entity, API or capability contract that requires review in its new implementation card.
classification_rules.unresolved: A product policy that remains open; historical conservative construction values do not settle it.
classification_rules.capability_classification: Every capability below is a proposed catalog contract. This classification does not remove confirmed product outcomes, settle open policies, or imply any implementation.
classification_rules.reset: All inherited capability implementation states are planned and all successor verification states are not-run. No old task progress, tests, validators or output evidence is carried over.

confirmed.description: 全新独立产品；不读取、探测、导入、迁移或兼容旧 PMM 数据库及备份。
.NET 10 / C# 14；一个 Kestrel 宿主承载 Razor MVC、HTTP 和 MCP。
Bootstrap 5、jQuery、Axios 随产品本地打包；SQLite 3 / EF Core 10 Code First；HostedServices 持久任务；不引入 Redis 或外部消息中间件。
采用 xUnit、真实隔离 SQLite 与临时文件系统、API 合同及 Playwright；Windows、Linux、macOS 的证据分别记录。
GitHub、Actions、Issues；Bash 和 PowerShell 7 的行为按实际平台验证。
规则加 TMDB 为默认识别路径；AI 可选；MCP 客户端提案不隐式启用付费 AI。
完整产品范围保留本地作品、人工资料、复杂季集覆盖、保留原版的主动音轨处理和受控来源目标重叠。
默认不自动覆盖；替换前保全；撤销结果服从实际磁盘事实；UI、HTTP、MCP 共用领域规则。
已确认视觉方向仅为设计参考；对象级播放和下载链接不扩展为媒体下载器或播放服务。
